faq.label: Frequently asked questions
faq.title: Questions you might have
faq.q0: How long does a project take?
faq.a0: It depends on scope. A typical corporate website takes 3-6 weeks; larger products and apps take longer. We give you a clear timeline after the first call.
faq.a1: We prepare a fixed-scope quote for each project. Once you tell us what you want to build, we come back within 48 hours with a clear plan and an honest estimate.
faq.q2: Do you only design, or do you build software too?
faq.a2: We work end to end. Strategy, brand identity, interface design, and software development all move within one senior team.
faq.q3: Do you offer support after launch?
faq.a3: Yes. We stay with you after launch through maintenance, performance optimization, content updates, and growth plans.
faq.q4: Can we work remotely, from a different city or country?
faq.a4: Yes. We run the process remotely with transparent, regular updates. Location doesn't matter.
faq.q5: What does the process look like?
faq.a5: We start with discovery and alignment, move through weekly build loops, and finish with post-launch measurement.

services.ctaTitle: The right start for your brand
services.ctaDescription: Tell us what you want to do, and we'll come back within 48 hours with a clear plan.
services.approach0Desc: We understand your goal, your users and the reality of the work. We don't jump to solutions before asking the right question.
services.approach1Desc: Strategy, design and delivery move as one team. Every part is made to talk to the others.
services.approach2Desc: After launch we look at the data, improve and grow. The work doesn't end at launch.
services.identityProblem: If your brand isn't recognized at a glance, even the best work stays invisible. A consistent, memorable identity is where trust begins.
services.webProblem: Your site isn't a showcase; it's the center of how you win customers. If it's slow or confusing, visitors leave before deciding.
services.appsProblem: Scattered tools and manual tracking only get you so far. Moving your operation into a custom system makes everything faster.
services.seoProblem: If people can't find you on Google, existing isn't enough. Set up right, you show up first the moment they search.
services.socialProblem: Random posting doesn't build a brand. Planned, on-brand content turns followers into customers over time.
services.adsProblem: Ad budgets don't run on guesswork. Campaigns set up right show where every dollar goes and what it returns.
services.productionProblem: Attention is measured in seconds. A well-shot video or image says more, faster, than paragraphs of text.
services.careProblem: Launch is a beginning, not an end. Without regular care and improvement, even the best site slowly falls behind.

about.heroTitle: A studio built for brands that refuse to blend in
about.heroDescription: We're a senior team of designers and engineers who'd rather do a few things impeccably than many things adequately. We partner closely with ambitious companies and treat your product like our own.
about.valuesDescription: Principles that shape how we work, what we build, and who we partner with.
about.value0Body: Every detail serves a purpose. We obsess over typography, motion, and interaction until the experience feels inevitable, not designed.
about.value1Body: Strategy, design, and engineering run on the same sprint. Decisions stay with the people who made them.
about.value2Body: We build with production in mind from day one. Analytics, performance, accessibility, all baked in from the start.
about.value3Body: Weekly updates, shared Figma files, documented decisions. You always know where the project stands.
about.teamDescription: Senior-only, cross-functional, and fully committed. Every person on the team ships. No account managers, no middlemen.
